summary: Retested WebSocket real-time propagation after fix moving endpoint to /api/ws. All 4 targeted scenarios passed with two independent reception browser contexts.

test_results.ws_handshake_open_to_/api/ws: PASS (both contexts opened wss://chair-board.preview.emergentagent.com/api/ws and stayed open; no close/error frames on the app WS)
test_results.test_1_create_propagation: PASS - Context A created booking (Chair 1, 09:00, 30min, unique patient 'WSTest 60181'); Context B rendered the occupied slot within ~3s without refresh.
test_results.test_2_status_arrived_propagation: PASS - Context A set status=arrived; Context B slot class updated to 'slot occupied arrived' and pill text 'Arrived' without refresh.
test_results.test_3_cancel_propagation: PASS - Context A clicked booking-cancel-appt-button; Context B slot disappeared / re-rendered without refresh.
test_results.test_4_activity_live_update: PASS - Context B switched to Live activity; Context A created booking 'ActTest 75205'; row appeared in B's activity view without manual refresh.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py: @app.websocket is registered on the app, not the /api router - explicit '/api/ws' path is fine but consider moving to api router for consistency.
Board.jsx / ActivityView.jsx WS listeners have no auto-reconnect on close; a network blip will silently break realtime until page reload. Consider a small reconnect w/ backoff.
WS broadcast payload uses only {date} filter - fine for schedule but Activity view could also filter to avoid unnecessary reloads.
seed_data_creation: Two bookings created for reception user on today's date (Chair 1, 09:00). One cancelled during Test 3, the second ('ActTest ...') remains active - main agent may want to clean up.
context_for_next_testing_agent: WebSocket propagation is fully working after moving endpoint to /api/ws. Playwright confirmed WS opens to wss://.../api/ws in both contexts and receives push events triggering re-fetches on Board and ActivityView. No further action required on this bug.
rca of the issue: Iteration 5: WS route was outside /api and Kubernetes ingress only proxies /api/* to backend, so wss handshake failed. Fix: move backend to @app.websocket('/api/ws') and set frontend WS_URL to `${REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL.replace(/^http/, 'ws')}/api/ws`. Confirmed resolved.
